units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 9:2">Ḥull. IX, 2</cite> <he>ח׳ של ישוב</he> domesticated swine; <he>ח׳ הבר</he> wild boar.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>מה איסור … לְהַחֲ׳ וכ׳</he> is the swine more strictly forbidden than other unclean animals?—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13:5">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> <he>ואת הח׳ זו פרס</he> (read <cite ref="T00390"><he>רומי</he></cite> or <he>אדום</he>).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מה ח׳ וכ׳</he> as the swine … stretches out its cloven feet (sign of cleanness), … so does the Roman government &c., v. <cite ref="B00629"><he>בִּימָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:1">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>, beg.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲזִירִים</he>, <he>חֲזִירִין</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:9">Kidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>תשעה נטלו ח׳</he> nine (measures of plagues) did swines receive.
B. Kam. VII, 7; a. e.—Fem. חֲזִירָה, חֲזִירְתָּה sow.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:15">Ib. to I, 15</cite> <he>לח׳ כדת וכ׳</he> the swine (Vashti) to be treated according to law, but the holy people &c.!, v. <cite ref="A01683"><he>אַכְזְרִיּוּת</he></cite>.
